GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C (LON:GFTU) had its target price hoisted by Canaccord Genuity from GBX 845 ($11.67) to GBX 850 ($11.74) in a research report sent to investors on Friday morning. The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock. 
Other equities analysts have also recently issued research reports about the company. Numis Securities reiterated an add rating and set a GBX 850 ($11.74) target price on shares of GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C in a report on Thursday, January 11th. Berenberg Bank upgraded GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C to a buy rating and increased their target price for the stock from GBX 800 ($11.05) to GBX 920 ($12.71) in a report on Tuesday, February 20th. Liberum Capital reiterated a hold rating and set a GBX 830 ($11.47) target price on shares of GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C in a report on Monday, February 19th. Finally, Peel Hunt reiterated a hold rating and set a GBX 780 ($10.78) target price on shares of GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C in a report on Thursday, November 9th. Five research analysts have rated the stock with a hold rating and two have assigned a buy rating to the company. The stock currently has a consensus rating of Hold and a consensus price target of GBX 844.14 ($11.66). Get GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD 1 C alerts: 
GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT ( LON GFTU ) opened at GBX 790 ($10.91) on Friday. GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT has a 1-year low of GBX 607 ($8.39) and a 1-year high of GBX 851 ($11.76). The business also recently disclosed a dividend, which will be paid on Friday, April 6th. Stockholders of record on Thursday, March 8th will be issued a GBX 10.25 ($0.14) dividend. This is a boost from GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C’s previous dividend of $5.25. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Thursday, March 8th. This represents a dividend yield of 1.31%. 
GRAFTON GROUP PLC UT (1 ORD, 1 C Company Profile 
Grafton Group plc engages in the merchanting, retailing, and mortar manufacturing businesses in Belgium, Ireland, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. Its Merchanting segment distributes building and plumbing materials to professional trades people engaged in residential repair, maintenance, and improvement projects, as well as in residential and other new build construction.
